description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_ftp class for validating FTP URIs as per RFC 1738. It includes properties for default port, browsability, hierarchy, and a method for URI validation that handles type code extraction and encoding.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_ftp
classes.description: A class for validating FTP URIs according to RFC 1738, extending the base URI scheme class.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates and processes the given FTP URI, handling type code extraction and encoding, and resetting the query component.
